notes.note: Jones kicked 1.3 from his 13 disposals. This was his best since the byes.
Jones battled his way to 9 disposals this week. He is going to have these low scores unfortunately.
10 touches at 50% and 2 behinds summed up Jones' night. Not one to remember for him or owners.
Quiet day for Jones with just the 9 disposals at 55% efficiency and a goal.
This was the best we have seen from Jones since round 4 with a goal from his 11 disposals.
Jones remains in the 50s for the fourth week in a row now and he has a BE that is only just below this. It is time to trade him out.
Jones was good in the third term when the Dogs got back into the game and he ended with 18 disposals. He is doing enough to keep his BE at bay and contribute.

Jones started with a bang having 41 points in the first term but really slowed down from there with just 18 in the remaining three quarters. A goal and 12 disposals with this his best in the last three weeks.
12 disposals and 2 goals for Jones but he also gave away three free kicks. He made his BE and his new one at 48 is still quite achievable. Use him on your field again this week.
Artie Jones had his lowest score outside of opening round. He still made us money and has a new BE of 28. He looks to be solid in the team so we can use him in the byes but the cash gen won't be big.

Jones has been a popular trade in over the last two weeks and he did fine the footy on 16 occasions with this his second best score of the season. With the 21 out of his cycle now his BE remains low at 1.
